rows.reasoning: Thompson voted Yea on final House passage of HJR 3 (2014), a single-subject joint resolution whose whole operative content is a new constitutional section: "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text both defines marriage as one man and one woman and bars recognising any other marriage, which is the rung reading "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman." The 57-40 tally is not near-unanimous, and the resolution says nothing about civil unions, so it does not drop to the rung that would "Recognize civil unions for same-sex couples, but reserve marriage for opposite-sex couples."
